claims.statement: For the branch-addition weighted-deck recurrence W'=B_r W+r B_(r-1)C+(rL^r-Nz)E, the signed correction is not coefficientwise nonnegative even at a rank in the new guarded band: with 150 arity-2 branches (N=300), append r=2 and k=4, the correction coefficient is -4364800.
claims.scope: Exact bounded obstruction to coefficientwise positivity of the correction term only. The profile is an ordinary path-star with all 300 original tip tags counted, one additional arity-2 branch, N'=302, and 1<=k with 2k=8<=N'+2. No actual first-descent eligibility or strict selector premise is asserted; the full weighted minor at this rank is positive.
claims.reason: The recurrence identity and in-guard negative correction coefficient replay exactly. At k=4, the full weighted minor is +185586251584170562390, so this retains only the coefficientwise-correction obstruction and not a counterexample to the guarded weighted-deck LR target.

limitations: The bounded example has no actual first descent, actual eligible p, strict selector flags, or graph-level selection.
A negative recurrence summand does not imply a negative full weighted minor; the full minor is positive at the displayed rank and checked guarded boundaries.
No universal invariant paying the signed correction or proof of the primary selected-payment predicate is established.
